duvet noun

also quilt, comforter, eiderdown

classical

strāgulum, strāgulī n.

noun, second declension

The lexicon’s word for the duvet, as in the Sailor and Waves entry.

Other words

  • diplois

    avoid · medieval · M-O s.v. bedclothes: comforter

    Morgan–Owens’s word, but in Lewis & Short a double cloak, so it is not used here.

See also blanket, bedspread, Sailor and Waves / duvet sea game / bedtime / balance / falling / tumbling.
